verification_policy: Proposed behavioral evidence only. This does not edit the907 ledger or mechanically mark capabilities verified. Named logs prove specific exercised behavior; suite verdicts are reported with their recorded freshness. Hosted platform execution remains separate evidence. Supported typed JSON adaptations are described per row; confirmed retry, panic, entropy and home-path gaps have actual regression proof rather than blanket dynamic-object exceptions. No new test or source ID is introduced.

config-change.assertion_mechanism: 71 direct mutation/lock-owner/type/refusal observations and60 extension admission/cache/byte outcomes; actual valid extension folder and full persisted JSON comparisons.

archive-backup.assertion_mechanism: Real archive contains profile metadata and owned binary session tree; round trip compares contents; actual lease, links/protected-root and output ownership controls refuse unsafe backup operations.

archive-restore.assertion_mechanism: 12 name-ownership rows plus real staging/session swap/rollback; independent concurrent editor survives failing restore; binary session contents and typed retained/destination/cause paths are inspected.

atomic.assertion_mechanism: 12 independently frozen writer-byte inputs, repeated publication and owned-temp cleanup; real later-write failure restores exact byte/absence snapshots; failed rollback preserves primary cause and every casualty.
